title: Principality of Valona and Kanina
capsule: By this 1395–1422 phase the principality was held through the Balšić line — Balsha II had acquired Valona and Kanina in 1372 as the dowry of his Muzaka bride — passing to his daughter Ruđina Balšić and her husband Mrkša Žarković (r. 1396–1414). Widowed in 1414, Ruđina ruled alone, vainly offering to cede the territory to Venice for protection before the Ottomans conquered Valona and Kanina in 1417.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The principality's core territory—the hinterland of Vlorë, Fier, and Berat—is described in Venetian and Serbian sources, but precise borders fluctuated considerably as rival Albanian lords competed for control. Capsule researched for this polity/era specifically (confidence: high).
